name: Rindou
source:
Mysterious and aloof, Rindou resides in the inner most chambers of the mansion and rarely leaves her quarters: even to eat or socialize. Her alabaster skin and blood red eyes create a foreboding air, yet she is always seen with a kind smile and knowing expression.

[From [url=http://www.erogereview.com/2007/12/25/shinjyu-no-yakata/]Eroge Review[/url]]
